## Progress

- [PR #57](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/57) (re-opened from #54, which merged into a stale branch): /trust with the six designed blocks and footer; policy versions and sub-processors from PublicSite/trust-centre.json (reloads on change, overridable by app settings, versioned in git), each with its effective date or "Not yet in effect"
- Demo request form (contact fields only, patient-information warning): server validation, anti-forgery, 5/hour per client, honeypot and minimum fill time; stored by the new Leads module (leads schema, insert/read-only role) and emailed to the founder without the free-text message (local SMTP sink)
- Certification lint test over all public copy (en/hi/ar) and the content file; honeypot, rate limit and anti-forgery tests mutation-checked; browser-verified without JavaScript in English and Arabic (axe clean, rows and emails checked); Lighthouse mobile 100 on /trust and /ar/trust (local)
- Left: final policy and sub-processor text and dates after legal review (MDV-P1-044); transactional email provider instead of SMTP; back-office view of requests (P5); automated retention (MDV-P5-025)

## Description

Trust centre with the six blocks (Data residency, Consent model, AI drafts, Retention, Audit, Sub-processors) and a dated list of policy versions and sub-processors; footer "We describe our controls; we do not claim certifications we have not obtained." Demo request form (name, organisation, role, country, email/phone, message) with no free-text PHI warning and rate limiting/bot protection.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** All six blocks render with the designed copy; policy versions and sub-processors show effective dates.
- [ ] **AC2.** No page claims a certification (lint check for "ISO 27001 certified", "HIPAA compliant" etc. in public copy).
- [ ] **AC3.** Demo requests are stored, emailed to the founder, rate-limited and protected against bots; the form warns not to include patient information.
- [ ] **AC4.** Content is editable without redeploy (Markdown files or settings) and versioned.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
